tracks.notes: Buy one NO on every visible leg of a NegRisk event when the NO asks sum below K-1, then convert the set to K-1 USDC through the NegRiskAdapter (one-way NO->collateral, no resolution wait). tracks.notes: Buy one YES on every leg of an exclusive event when the asks sum below 1. No converter exists for YES->collateral, so positions are held to resolution: the ledger marks them at mid and locked_capital / payoff_at_resolution report the lockup. Augmented events (hidden placeholders) and groups without an exclusivity guarantee are refused.
